about_what: Full app and data backup and restore as root, driven entirely from a WebUI. The open, root-native successor to Swift Backup, Neo-Backup and Android-DataBackup.
ui_restore_test: Test only (extract, do not touch the live app)
confirm_delete_backup: Delete this backup? This cannot be undone.
ui_job_search: Search apps by name or package
job_restore_warn: Scheduled restore overwrites the app data with the latest backup on each run.

settings_auto_backup: Back up apps automatically on install and update
settings_auto_hint: When on, newly installed or updated apps are backed up in the background. The first run only records what is installed, so turning this on never backs up everything at once.
settings_blocklist_hint: Apps on this list are skipped by automatic and scheduled backups.
ui_block_pick: Apps to exclude (pick one or more)
special_hint: Back up system-wide data: messages, contacts and call log, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Restore is same-device and needs a reboot.
msg_syssettings_warning: This backs up and, on restore, overwrites device-wide system settings such as display, sound and input options. It is optional and off by default, applies to the same device, and every value it changes is recorded in the activity log.
special_ack_label: I understand this overwrites live system data and needs a reboot
special_ack_warning: This replaces the current messages, contacts, Wi-Fi or Bluetooth state with the backup. It only applies after a reboot and can only be relied on when restoring to the same device and ROM.
special_pass_msg: This special backup is encrypted. Enter its passphrase.
settings_spoof: Set install source to Play Store on restore
settings_spoof_hint: Restored apps report the Play Store as their install source instead of looking sideloaded. On by default; you can turn it off here or per restore, and when off the original install source is kept.
ui_spoof_installer: Set install source to Play Store
ui_deep_spoof: Also forge the initiating source (edits packages.xml, needs a reboot)
ui_deep_spoof_note: Advanced. Makes the app look fully Play-installed (initiating package and source), not just the installer. The system package database is backed up first; the change applies after a reboot.
ui_sysmount_note: This never changes the real /system partition. It adds the app through a VDBackup sub-module that the root manager mounts. Privileged apps may also need a privapp-permissions allowlist.
ui_sysmount_live: This device can mount it instantly, no reboot (NoMount).
ui_sysmount_reboot: It will be mounted after a reboot.
ui_sysmount_nonomount: No NoMount module found; your root manager will mount it after a reboot. Install NoMount for instant, no-reboot mounts.
msg_sysmount_live: ${pkg} is now mounted as a system app.
msg_sysmount_reboot: ${pkg} will be mounted as a system app after a reboot.
special_portable: Also export a portable copy (SMS, call log, contacts as JSON)
about_prov_hint: Source and SHA-256 of every binary and library bundled for this device's ABI.
about_sib_vdinfos: a device method debugger: reads each item through every method that can read it and compares them side by side.
about_sib_vdgoogle: your Google services (RCS, Wallet, Play Integrity attestations), read on your device with no internet.
about_sib_copg: a device spoofer that turns a fresh fingerprint into a coherent, consistent profile.
ui_pathbk_hint: Back up any folder or file by its absolute path, with the same compression and encryption as an app backup. Restore writes it back to the same path.
